title: 12-name watchlist · 07 Nov 2026 (Sat) · 00:00 SGT
summary: Apple’s reported bond offering rises to about $7.5 billion; Amazon begins invitation-only text shopping. A late-observed Alphabet holding disclosure corrects a prior coverage omission. Shared policy and US-session updates are separate from company research. All 12 saved closes and 72 return baselines were rechecked.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 7 November 00:00 SGT (6 November 16:00 UTC). New-research window: 6 November 19:30 SGT to the cutoff, covering the prior 20:00 SGT edition with a 30-minute overlap. The Alphabet article at 19:13:29 SGT is explicitly included as a late-observed prior-window correction. News access is partial: Reuters text was retrieved through search, with direct-page access limited; issuer checks and exact timing vary by name. Ten accessible SEC feeds had no in-window filings; Meta had a duplicate-terms filing, while Amazon SEC remained unavailable. Earlier editions and reports are retained unchanged.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 5 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo daily bars retrieved at 16:05:36–16:05:43 UTC on 6 Nov verify all 12 historical closes. Exact Nov 5 vendor quote timestamps are retained from archived source evidence whose prices match these newly retrieved bars; current Nov 6 intraday metadata and prices are excluded. Daily changes compare Nov 5 with Nov 4 ordinary closes; adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. BRK.B quote time is 21:04:07 UTC; other quote times are 21:00:01 or 21:00:02 UTC. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These are saved observations, not live quotes.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes, adjusted for splits and dividend/capital-gain distributions. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages are rounded to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 5 Oct, 4 Sep, 5 Aug, 2 Jul, 5 Jun and 5 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX.
caveats: News coverage is partial. Search silence does not prove no news. Reuters reporting is attributed separately from issuer releases and research analysis.
Amazon SEC and Micron IR prior HTTP 403 responses were respected without retry. Alphabet IR news-page access was unavailable; its holding item was independently checked against the original SEC 13F.

The Alphabet holding report was missed in the previous edition; it is a coverage correction, not a new event after the prior cutoff. The Apple size change is an update to one offering, not a second transaction.
The Reuters regular-session index snapshot updates the earlier premarket canonical story. Its 15:21 UTC observation is separate from initial publication and from the completed-session price tables.
The NVIDIA 6G blog timestamp is 16:00:35 UTC, after cutoff, and is excluded. Meta’s newly filed prospectus repeats previously covered financing terms and is not presented as a new financing.
Price and baseline checks use one vendor, Yahoo Finance, not cross-vendor corroboration. Exact historical quote timestamps come from preserved earlier source evidence, not current quote metadata.

Adjusted closes include the vendor’s split and distribution adjustments. Cents-first return arithmetic is reproducible from displayed inputs and can differ slightly from calculations using unrounded values.

research.headline: Amazon begins invitation-only Alexa shopping by text
facts: Amazon began rolling out text-based Alexa for Shopping to selected US customers, with wider availability planned over coming weeks.
Customers can request product searches, build carts, complete purchases and receive order updates by text.
research.analysis: Research analysis: Text-based shopping could reduce friction, but the release does not establish higher conversion or revenue.
research.risks: Rollout is initially limited, and adoption, transaction accuracy and privacy remain execution risks.
research.next_watch: Broader US rollout and evidence of use or sales impact.
